text:
nina: Azure marketplace put a hold on CP-Global's March payout - portal says 'SKU_SUFFIX_MISMATCH' and blocked disbursement. Anyone track this flow?
kevin-fin: invoice number?
nina: INV-AZ-202603-4421. Their invoice lines show sku 'rdw-enterprise' but marketplace expects 'rdw-enterprise-chan'.
billing-bot: Alert recorded at 2026-03-09T11:07Z. Hold reason: SKU_SUFFIX_MISMATCH. Hold ID: HLD-8442.
rahul: We recently changed our internal mapping to standardize suffix handling; maybe the partner used legacy naming. Do we have a fallback mapping enabled?
kevin-fin: our ingestion accepts canonical sku but marketplace requires exact match. If partner invoice doesn't match, Azure auto-holds.
partner-billing: We're seeing this from partner side too - their billing system stripped the suffix during export. Partner says they use an older connector. They've uploaded a corrected CSV to their portal but need our confirmation to reprocess.
nina: Can we provisionally approve payout to avoid partner delay? If we credit and it turns out they overbilled we need a reversal path. Finance?
kevin-fin: provisional payout is risky without proof. Suggest provisional 'suspense' credit to partner account (not cash payout) so they can cover short-term cashflow, while we await corrected invoice. Limit it to $2,000.
rahul: also ask partner to include the marketplace invoice reference in the corrected file so Azure will auto-release. Otherwise manual release takes 48-72h.
partner-billing: confirmed we'll resend corrected invoice tonight with marketplace ref. Also we'll attach the original PO: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/po/CPG-PO-2026-01.pdf
kevin-fin: Finance approves a suspense credit up to $2k provided partner submits corrected invoice by EOD local time. If not, we'll hold until reconciliation. Tag legal if contract amendment is needed.
billing-bot: Action logged: SUSPENSE_CREDIT_CREATED amount=2000. Notifications: ar@redwood, partner-ops@redwood.
nina: noted. I'll monitor marketplace release and update ledger when Azure clears the hold. If partner issues a corrected invoice, AR will reverse the suspense credit and schedule normal payout.
partner-billing: Thanks — will update this thread once the new invoice is submitted. :thumbsup:
